title: The installer judges back-compat shim rows that the bundle itself disables, so `dsh plugin add` is rejected and rolled back

reported.symptom: `dsh plugin add` of the TUI plugin fails on 0.2.0-rc.1 with two incompatibility messages naming packages the user never asked for, and the installation is rolled back (package.json, pnpm-lock.yaml and node_modules restored). Users read it as the installer 'misreporting dependency versions'
reported.runtime_trace: @deepseek-ai/dsh-code-runtime-worker-thread@0.1.5-rc.3 与 DSH 0.2.0-rc.1 不兼容（要求 @deepseek-ai/dsh-code-runtime ^0.1.5-rc.3, @deepseek-ai/dsh-session ^0.1.5-rc.3, @deepseek-ai/dsh-timeout ^0.1.5-rc.3）; @deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-presets@0.1.5-rc.3 与 DSH 0.2.0-rc.1 不兼容（要求 @deepseek-ai/dsh-agent, dsh-atomic-write, dsh-invariants, dsh-home-paths, dsh-scope, dsh-session, dsh-session-projection, dsh-settings, dsh-system-prompt, dsh-typert-protocol, dsh-tools — all ^0.1.5-rc.3）
user_hypotheses: the installer misreads dependency versions (close: it reads the right manifests from the wrong rows)
the packages are actually needed by 0.2.0-rc.1 (they are not: the rows are disabled shims)
reported.root_cause: bundleComponentManifests collects every row.name from the bundle's composed insert patches without consulting `disabled`/`!!js`, so the two pre-rename shim rows are judged by evaluatePluginCompatibility even though the startup preflight skips them
reported.fix_verified_by_reporter: none verified in the report; the source path is pinned (boot/plugin-manager/src/operations.ts:249 vs boot/app-boot/src/compatibility-preflight.ts:122)

deviations: candidate mode: the installer refused the operation and rolled it back, so nothing was installed and there is no profile to replay

both rejected modules are materialised as candidate manifests (the label names one); the report names the same three unmet peers for the worker-thread shim, which is why the requirement key is unambiguous
the `disabled: !!js(...)` row semantics are not modelled — the case tests what the defendant actually judged (the two manifests), which is exactly the defect the report describes
the rollback path (package.json / lockfile / node_modules restore) is not modelled
